$schema_note: Critical-path e2e contract. Middle ground: not every click, but every user-visible capability we ship must keep a named check. Epics add rows when they land a vertical slice.

context.note: Fingerprint of the domain context this contract was last reviewed against. When CONTEXT.md or docs/adr change, review the rows below against the new capabilities, then restamp: node test/app/coverage-contract.mjs --stamp

paths.user_action: Scroll the first-run intro through the brand story and the Party pitch; the footer's Skip intro becomes Get started once it is read, and a returning guest never sees it again
paths.check: the intro is a scroll story: Skip becomes Get started once read, and a returning guest never sees it

paths.user_action: See what the app is for, and the nearest-World offer
paths.check: the welcome gate is step one of two: what the app is for, and the ask

paths.user_action: Confirm nearest World and load its map
paths.check: the nearest-park button asks before building that park

paths.user_action: Read a park map that still draws what was asked for — coaster track heavy enough to navigate by, walkways and broad areas as shapes with smooth bends rather than hairlines
paths.check: the map still draws the decisions it was asked for

paths.user_action: Pinch or pan the map and have Places arrive rather than pop
paths.check: a Place that enters on a pinch or a pan fades in rather than snapping

paths.check: verdicts respond to height

paths.check: Start hands the screen over to the walk

paths.user_action: Route preview names surveyed queue entrances (Cedar Point)
paths.check: cedar point route preview names surveyed queue entrances

paths.user_action: NEED HELP reaches other phones

paths.check: offline profile identity survives without network

paths.user_action: First-time visitor can complete toilet → food → walk

paths.note: Was clerk-profile-oauth, naming a Profile gate that carried Sign in and Guest together. That gate (AuthGate) is mounted nowhere — in-place OAuth on it broke live — so the row named a shape the app retired and a check nothing had written (#24). Google/Apple on /sign-in is the row below.

paths.user_action: Wear the Pixel tycoon Skin and keep a map to navigate by
paths.check: wearing Pixel tycoon keeps the MapLibre map (OSM until a bake exists)
paths.note: Was iso-custom-map. ADR-0021 clause 6 converted the kit off iso and slice h14 retired the iso Custom map; the row outlived the capability it claimed. The Wear still ships, so the row names what it does now — the check asserts the iso layer is gone (#24).

paths.check: wearing Watercolor quest draws the baked world image under the overlay

paths.user_action: Pinch from park overview in to one ride and see detail emerge, never a hard band cut or a tilt and restyle in the same instant
paths.check: crossing each band boundary keeps a parent placeholder drawn, ramps added content across the crossfade, and holds the pitch ease off the boundary

paths.check: the offline action states its size, runs only on the guest's choice, and no pyramid downloads on Skin wear
